title: Probability under mask selection
statement: For any real bias parameter $\rho$, any Boolean mask, and any predicate $A$ on Boolean strings, the biased probability that applying the mask to a random string of length equal to the mask length yields a string satisfying $A$ equals the biased probability of $A$ on strings whose length is the number of true entries in the mask.
hypotheses_covered: the mask is a list of Booleans
$A$ is a predicate on Boolean strings
